newsitem.title: USA: Tremont to buy back up to 2.0 mln shares.
newsitem.headline: Tremont to buy back up to 2.0 mln shares.

text.p: Tremont Corp said Friday its board has authorized the repurchase of up to 2.0 million of its common shares.
The shares represent about 27 percent of Tremont's 7.4 million shares outstanding, the company said.
It said shares may be purchased in open market transactions, including block purchases, or in privately negotiated deals from from time to time as its financial and market conditions permit.

The buyback program does not include specific price targets or timetables and may be suspended at any time, it said. Depending on financial and market conditions, the program could be terminated prior to completion, it said. Tremont added it will use its cash on hand to buy the shares and shares repurchased will be added to its treasury and could be used for future acquisitions or other corporate purposes.

Tremont is a holding company with operations in the titanium metals business, conducted through Titanium Metals Corp, a 30-percent-owned affiliate, and in the titanium dioxide business, conducted through NL Industries Inc, an 18-percent-owned affiliate.
